title: Topo Analysis
description: Complete structural intelligence for a codebase. Fully computed, lossless. Any formatter can render this without additional computation.

internal_only.description: Whether only internal (first-party) code was analyzed.

coverage.description: How much of the codebase was analyzed.

analyzed_nodes.description: Nodes in the analyzed graph (after projection/scoping).

parsed_nodes.description: Nodes in the raw parsed graph (before projection).

parsed_edges.description: Edges in the raw parsed graph.

spectral.description: Spectral decomposition of the graph Laplacian. The mathematical foundation for module detection and structural analysis. Null if the graph is too small for meaningful decomposition.

fiedler_value.description: Algebraic connectivity. Higher = more connected. 0 = disconnected.

eigenvalues.description: Leading non-trivial eigenvalues. Gaps reveal natural cluster boundaries.

nodes_covered.description: How many nodes received spectral fingerprints.

coverage_ratio.description: Fraction of analyzed nodes covered by spectral decomposition.

largest_component_ratio.description: Fraction of nodes in the largest connected component.

architecture.description: Detected architectural structure as a graph. Modules are nodes, cross-module dependencies are edges. This is the structural X-ray of the codebase.

modules.description: Structural modules (detected clusters). Each module is a group of code entities that are more tightly coupled to each other than to the rest of the codebase.

size.description: Number of code entities in this module.

members.description: Node IDs belonging to this module.

cohesion.description: Internal tightness (avg intra-module distance). Lower = tighter.

separation.description: Distinctness from other modules (nearest centroid distance). Higher = more distinct.

confidence.description: How reliably this module was detected. 0-1.

unassigned.description: True if this is a catch-all for nodes that didn't cluster.

top_terms.description: Top TF-IDF terms from node ID tokenization. Available without semantic embeddings.

semantic_coherence.description: Average pairwise cosine similarity of semantic embeddings within this module. Null if module < 6 members or semantic analysis disabled.

dependencies.description: Directed dependencies between modules. Each entry represents aggregated edges crossing a module boundary.

weight.description: Total number of edges crossing this boundary.

edge_kinds.description: Breakdown by relationship type (calls, imports, etc.).

package_fallback.description: True if spectral analysis was attempted but couldn't beat random partitioning. When true, modules reflect directory/package structure rather than spectral findings.

package_agreement.description: Comparison of spectral modules against declared package boundaries. Present only when the input has 2+ packages.

nmi.description: NMI between spectral and package partitions. 1.0 = perfect alignment, 0.0 = no mutual information.

module_composition.description: Per-module breakdown of which packages contributed members.

cross_package.description: True if this module draws members from 2+ packages.

roles.description: Structural role of every analyzed node. Roles are derived from graph position (degree, betweenness, flow direction), not from code content.

betweenness.description: Fraction of shortest paths passing through this node.

local_variation.description: Semantic local variation: how much this node disagrees with its structural neighbors. Only present with semantic analysis.

issues.description: Actionable structural issues, prioritized by severity. Each issue is a structural concern that a developer should evaluate.

suggested_module.description: For misplaced_concern: the module the node should move to.

similarity_own.description: For misplaced_concern: cosine similarity to own module centroid.

similarity_best.description: For misplaced_concern: cosine similarity to best other module centroid.

root_cause.description: For cross_package_coupling: classified root cause (shared_domain_concept, incomplete_split, accidental_coupling).

semantic_coherence.description: For cross_package_coupling: mean pairwise cosine similarity of module members' semantic embeddings.

health.description: Structural health. Newman's modularity Q measures how well detected modules explain the edge structure vs random assignment. Null if the graph has no edges.

modularity_q.description: Newman's modularity Q. Higher = module boundaries explain more of the edge structure. >0.3 significant, >0.5 strong, 0 = no better than random.

spectral_coverage_ratio.description: Fraction of nodes that received spectral fingerprints. Low values indicate disconnected components limiting analysis quality.

self_edge_drop_ratio.description: Fraction of scoped edges that collapsed into self-edges at the current analysis level.

semantic_smoothness.description: Rayleigh quotient measuring how smoothly semantics vary over the graph. Lower = better organized. Null if semantic analysis not enabled.

semantic_structural_ami.description: Adjusted Mutual Information between structural and semantic partitions. Higher = better alignment.

semantic_energy_profile.description: GFT energy profile: how semantic disagreement distributes across structural scales.

semantic_enabled.description: Whether semantic analysis was attempted and the quality gate passed.
